$comment: Maps the labels used in the source spreadsheets to ids in the app's taxonomy.
This file is the source of truth and is meant to be reviewed and edited by hand.
Run `npm run content:map` after changing it: that regenerates the TypeScript copy
the browser bundles (packages/core/src/content/htet-topic-map.ts), and a test
fails if the two ever drift apart.
A label that is not listed here is NOT silently dropped and NOT guessed at. The
importer rejects the row naming the unmapped value, so a new topic appearing in a
future paper is a visible failure rather than a question filed under the wrong

level.$comment: The 'HTET' column holds the post, which selects the paper: PRT is htet-l1, TGT htet-l2, PGT htet-l3. The importer stores the TeachingLevel those papers carry.

subject.$comment: GK.xlsx is the 10-mark Haryana block, not general awareness — its own topics are Haryana history, Haryana welfare schemes and Haryana culture.

topic.$comment: 27 CDP labels onto 9 CDP topics, 8 GK labels onto 5 Haryana GK topics. Where a source label spans two app topics the more specific one wins; those calls are noted.

notes.Language & Thought: Filed with Piaget/Kohlberg/Vygotsky because in TET papers this topic is Vygotsky's account of inner speech.
notes.Child as Learner: Filed under Growth & Development rather than Theories of Learning: the questions are about how a child develops, not about a named learning theory.
notes.Cognition & Emotions: Filed under Intelligence & Creativity, the nearest cognitive-processes topic in the taxonomy.
notes.Individual Differences: The app topic is 'Gender, Socialisation & Individual Differences', which names it explicitly.
notes.Environment: Haryana environment questions are geography questions here; the taxonomy has no separate environment topic under Haryana GK.
notes.Literature: Haryana literature sits with Art, Culture, Fairs & Festivals.
notes.hgk-sports: No source label maps to it. Left unused rather than forcing a label into it.
notes.cdp-rte: No source label maps to it. RTE questions in these papers are labelled under other headings.
